metadata.description: Curated 100-country slice of the OWID / UN World Population Prospects panel used by the Benford evaluation artifact. One row per country-year; only the RAW published population is stored, so the notebook recomputes log10, mantissa and the first digit under the artifact's own rule (first significant digit of the published figure, base 10, no truncation).
metadata.selection_rule: 100 countries at log-spaced quantiles of mean population over 1950-2023, restricted to those complete over the window; all 74 years kept per country so the year-parity fold split has both sides for every country.
metadata.note: The full artifact uses 236 countries x 74 years (17,464 rows); this demo uses 100 x 74. The reproduction of the headline is therefore approximate by construction: the cluster-calibrated verdict, the design effect and the reserved-fold confirmation bracket are what should be compared, not the exact third decimal of any statistic.
